verdict.summary: The shared batch-framing implementation correctly distinguishes top-level arrays, rejects an empty batch with a single invalid-request response, dispatches valid and malformed elements independently and in order, suppresses notification responses, and preserves the existing single-request path. Both server variants use the same core, and the tests exercise mixed batches, all-notification silence, malformed elements, stateful ordering, protocol negotiation, Solid authorization, and stdio framing. The public protocol-version claim and skill documentation are updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found in the diff.
